# S1 job tables (generated by gen/s1gen.py)

Each job: name (set, render_pb_pages P, runner knobs, regtimeline), then the exact tool
command.  The tool is `$T`, staged programs `$S`, the work directory `$W`.  `set`: control,
heldout, replicate.  The table files in `tables/` are the runner's input; this is a view.

## g-e1: 22 jobs, 21 conditions

```
E1 (geometry): Q273/Q210, the raise of the ZLS threshold below P = 0x420: ceiling or scene.
Control first (E704's 0x422 job).  The knob proof is per job: the job's own 0x0624 (first row
after the tool's start with 0x0724 non-zero; the first sample is the previous job's) = P - 0x22
(register readback of render_pb_pages shows only the write, the clamp is at use).
Fit/held out: the control reproduces a fit job of R2 (E704); every other job is held out.
Stop rule: a 'job hung' in any job stops the stage (knob stophang).
```

## g-e2a: 10 jobs, 8 conditions

```
E2 first part (geometry): Q211, the page need U of K-triangle scenes at P = 0x422.
-n K with --geometry 1..K-1 submits kicks 1..K-1 TA-only and kick K closes the scene; the tool
prints 'tri 1024x768 #k: geometry only, the scene left open' for each open kick (the option
proof).
U = peak of the page status 0x0724 low half; cross-check by the PB free-list walk (head - 1).
Prediction 'coverage-proxy' (NOT the proposal's HU1, which needs sgx-pipe's stream bytes): U =
2.2090 + 0.3469 m + 0.03189 t (m macrotiles, t tiles covered, 4x4 sampling),
least squares on the 10 known points (FIT; max residual 1.08 pages).  The six
scenes are an extrapolation of that proxy to multi-triangle unions: a match neither confirms nor
refutes HU1, a miss refutes only the proxy.  The scorer reports U - proxy, no pass/fail.
HU2 (U = m + c) fails ON THE FIT DATA (the ten known points), not on new data (PREFLIGHT.md).
The boundary and count jobs (g-e2b) are generated after this table by gen/gen_e2_boundary.py.
```

- `u-1-0x422`: control: must read 0x13 (E705, E625).  [control, P=0x422, knobs: stophang
  expectdiff, timeline]

  tri --width 1024 --height 768 -n 1 --keep-going --keep-overflow --wait-ms 20000 \
      --dump-render "$W/dump" --dump-each --words "$W/words" --regs 0x0700-0x074c
  ```

## g-e2b (generated after the PAUSE)

Boundary jobs P = U + 0x22 - 1 and U + 0x22 for each of the six scenes of g-e2a, and
two partial-render count jobs; `gen/gen_e2_boundary.py U.json`.  14 jobs when the
count jobs separate the (k, s) pairs, else 12; not in the totals.

## g-e3: 35 jobs, 31 conditions

```
E3 (geometry): Q230, what the TA writes for clipped, perspective and off-target triangles.
Offline first (done here): the three mte/rhw dumps (w = x + 2 per vertex) give the stored 1/w =
round-toward-zero float32 of the exact reciprocal (0x3f4ccccc, 0x3eba2e8b, 0x3f1d89d8 against the
nearest 0x...cd, 0x...8c, 0x...d9) in 9 of 9 vertices; those 9 are the FIT.  The packed x, y of
those jobs are unchanged (8, 56, 20): that vertex program does not divide x, y, so the division is
untested.  Every group's control comes first in its group and must reproduce a landed object
(E651)
or image (E194, E287, E650) before the group's cells count.  Offsets are the state block's
viewport x offset (word 6, absolute pixels, E061/E182), not distances.  Programs are the landed
mte
templates; the commands come from probe.tool_args, and --tri-v/--tri-unit are appended by hand
(probe.py does not model them).  35 jobs; the *-r2 jobs are replicates of one condition.
```

C (pixel): Q276, a guard that cannot hold.  E709's o4 guard is replaced by complementary
predicated writes of o1: tag 2 (marker*16 + 2) under p1, tag 2' (+0xc) under !p1.  The `!p1` write
is placed FIRST and the `p1` write second, so that if no gating exists (HN) both land and tag 2
wins
(the proposal listed the p1 write first, which makes HN predict tag 2' and indistinguishable from
HP/HA at K = 7: PREFLIGHT.md).  Every configuration runs as an x job and a y job (source pixel
identity needs the pair, as E709; the proposal's job list had x/y only for k7: 13 jobs, not 9).
o1 lands in the previous tile's region (E570): the scorer maps destination to source through the
pair.  Premise to confirm from E570 before reading: o1 lands for every source pixel.
```

  stophang]

  probe --tri pixel --temps 32 --pixels --dump-render "$W/dump" --width 64 --height 64 \
      --vtx-coords 2 --blk 4=0x00030001 --slot pixpds="$S/pds_iter_xy.bin:12" --slot \
      vtxuse="$S/vtx_coords.bin" "$S/s1c-e709-x.bin"
  ```

## p-g: 9 jobs, 5 conditions

```
G (pixel): Q280, the footprint's precision.  One operand ramps so that LOD*64 crosses the integer
n (13, 22, 56, 2: the steps of the misses) at column 32, with a pitch of 1/2048 of a 1/64 step per
column.  The proposal's 1/4096 pitch spans only +-32 columns = +-0.0078 of a step, narrower than
the
+-0.01 noise it wants to detect (+-40 columns), so the pitch is 1/2048 (+-0.0156 step).  u and v
are
constants (so that only the LOD varies along the row; E721's lf-r ladders also ramped u).  Whether
a
raw-dword point-sampled output changes at all with the LOD fraction is not shown by any record:
the control (E721's lf-r8, unchanged) and 'at least one transition per ladder' are the first
checks.
Cases are rebuilt from the p1141 lodg SETUP text with K, C replaced; nothing here reads a result.
```

## p-b2: 5 jobs, 5 conditions

```
B2 (pixel): Q200 second term, the lower-binade deviation of a dyadic plane.  d-ctl reproduces dp-
ax-b2
(E731) first.  Scorer: stored - trunc32(exact) in ulps per pixel; the map of non-zero pixels;
frozen
predictions are the region under HT (target-tied: the d-ctl map, in target coordinates) and under
HV
(vertex-tied: the d-ctl map translated by (64, 32)), the boundary line fitted on d-ctl's data,
written
before the run (predictions/p-b2.tsv + p-b2-set-*.bits).  d-tall / d-ygrad / d-b3 carry
qualitative
frozen predictions only (counts per tile row, orientation).  The rule for the term is not expected
to close here (the proposal says so): this maps the region.
```

- `d-ctl`: control: dp-ax-b2 as run (7680 pixels at -1 ulp, 1536 at -2).  [control, P=-, knobs:

      --depth-dump "$W/depth" --depth-pages 48 --poke blk:1=0x00400200 --pixels
  ```

## p-d: 7 jobs, 7 conditions

```
D (pixel): Q281, the 64 KiB scratch.  Texture base = the scratch buffer; probe --scratch-pages N
(16 to 64) enlarges it.  The three extents that faulted at 16 pages (84, 85, 170 KiB) fit in 64.
The probe fills the scratch with 0xD0000000 | i, so a read past the texture's own bytes returns
the
dword index: the A4 image hash of E722's frozen cases.json is the prediction under HB.  Knob
proof:
the probe's 'scratch at ... (N KiB)' line must say N = pages x 4.  Fit: none (E722's 13 of 16 fit
cases are the model; these are held out).  The two faulting jobs run last.
```

- `d-ok-64`: control: E722's passing case at 64 pages (extent 0x10000).  [control, P=-, knobs:

## p-f: 20 jobs, 10 conditions

```
F (pixel): Q076, the remaining pages, with debugfs alias_skip (a mask of firmware buffer ids,
bits 16 to 31 refused; applies to render VMs created after the write; a reset leaves it alone).
tri -n 2 --keep-going as E573/E592 ran it; each condition twice (the proposal's '11 jobs (2
repeats
each)' is 9 conditions = 20 jobs with f-dpm's two masks).  A fault in a pair job is HJ, a stated
hypothesis: measured (knob hypo:COND:2), not a stop.  f-ctl0 reproduces E573 and faults by design
(reset + health after); it is last: nothing depends on it, the knob proof is the read-back marker.
The mask is written, read back and marked in the kernel log
before each job and put back to 0 after it.  Buffer 9 is the TA3D control block (never masked
here).
f-dpm uses --keep-overflow (a partial render's ENOSPC is not a failure); P = 0x23.
```
